berlin.delivery: 🚚 Delivery — Berlin 🏪 Pickup Collect your order at our Berlin pickup point. Usually ready within 1–2 hours after confirmation. We will send the exact address after your order is accepted. 🚗 Courier Courier delivery across Berlin. Typical delivery window: same day or next day. Please provide a clear address and preferred time at checkout.
berlin.payment: 💳 Payment — Berlin • Cash on pickup or to the courier • Bank / card transfer: by request Payment details are sent together with your order confirmation.
berlin.contacts: 📞 Contacts Under development. If you have any questions, please ask them in our Reviews group — that is where we answer right now.

other.delivery: 🚚 Delivery — Other cities 📦 Postal delivery Shipping via national postal service. Please enter a complete postal address and preferred time at checkout.
